notes.subject: הואילו
notes.rationale: 'plis i gat' (be content/agree) — KJV 'be content', ylt 'please'; em i tok bilong ples, buk i no gat wanpela mining moa

notes.subject: אם אכזב
notes.rationale: KJV/JPS: 'sapos mi tok giaman' o 'mi no inap tok giaman long pes bilong yupela' — tok i no klia sapos em i askim o tok stret

notes.subject: Job i tokim ol fren bilong en
notes.rationale: Job i singautim ol: 'luklukim mi' — em i askim ol long lukluk long en yet

translation: Na nau, plis i gat, luklukim mi; long pes bilong yupela ⟨sapos⟩ mi tok giaman?
